THE DECISIVE CHECK passes: sampled at the midpoint of 8 lids' own tunnel-way span (the full-depth part, not the shallow ramp tip), CutAt reports the floor 4.5-5.7 m BELOW the uncut terrain every time (id=trench0..7, inside_below_m matches the DEPTH=5.4 constant almost exactly, e.g. 5.400/5.400/5.681/4.538), while a point offset past hw+CutBatter+30m reports an outside_diff_m of 0.0000 every time — proving CutAt only ever LOWERS the surface inside a real trench and leaves it bit-for-bit untouched outside one, exactly the citymap.js:3226-3229 contract.
